checkedAlternates.risk: stdin, stdout, and stderr are the three default POSIX file descriptors.
checkedAlternates.resolution: stdin is the sole input stream (group-1), while stdout and stderr are the two output streams (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: SIGHUP has numeric value 1 like the execute bit.
checkedAlternates.resolution: SIGHUP is an asynchronous process signal (group-4), not a file-mode permission bit (group-3).
